content:
Rapid Growth in the User Base

Google has passed a major milestone in the mobile app of its AI assistant Gemini. According to the latest data shared by the company, the app has exceeded the threshold of 750 million monthly active users (MAU). These figures show that, beyond its search engine infrastructure, Google is also strengthening its leadership position in the personal AI assistant market.

Android Integration and the Gemini 3 Effect

This rapid rise in user numbers is driven mainly by deep integration with the Android ecosystem. Having an infrastructure accessible on billions of devices gives the app an organic distribution advantage. In addition, the model capabilities introduced with the Gemini 3 launch have increased the app’s adoption rate.

Users’ app usage habits are concentrated mainly in the following areas:

  • Complex text generation and editing tasks.
  • Detailed visual analysis.
  • Advanced query answering.
  • Daily digital assistant tasks.

Competition and the State of the Market

The resulting user volume gives Google a significant advantage in its ongoing competition with OpenAI’s ChatGPT service. Industry data confirms that generative AI has moved beyond the early adoption stage and is evolving into mass use. Google continues its growth strategy to turn this broad user base into sustainable revenue models.
